mechanism: Given an input candidate set and declared axes, use {{compare}} under each axis's no-worse relation. Candidate X dominates Y when X is no worse than Y on every axis and, on at least one axis, Y is not no worse than X. Return every input candidate not dominated by another input candidate. Ordering or selecting among returned candidates is caller policy.
invariants: Dominance: X dominates Y iff X is no worse than Y on every declared axis and there is at least one axis on which Y is not no worse than X.
Frontier Completeness: Every undominated input candidate is returned, and no dominated input candidate is returned.
preconditions: At least two axes are declared.
Each axis supplies a reflexive, transitive no-worse relation applicable to every candidate pair.
